title: Error reasons and the read-only HOME
summary: Fault found in R8 order A: every Azure read failed after 0.1 s and cloudctl showed only "Traceback (most recent call last):", the first stderr line. Order C found the cause: Codex's sandbox mounts HOME read-only and az writes ~/.azure/az.sess on every start (OSError Errno 30). Since v0.2-dev1 a failed read reports the last non-blank stderr line (the exception), writes the last 12 stderr lines to the run log as "cloudctl: | ...", and adds a hint when the text contains Read-only file system. Any order that runs az, gcloud, oci or aws through cloudctl must say to run outside the sandbox.
authority: architecture Tom Dyer; ooRexx Cloud Control coded by Claude (Opus 5.5), 7 Nov 2026; v0.2-dev3 fixes by Claude (Opus 5.5) at Tom Dyer's instruction ("fix cloud controller", 26 Nov 2026 10:50); v0.1-dev4 bash adapters by ChatGPT/Codex
invariants: A failure is never read as absent
The reason is the exception line, not the traceback header
procedure: In orders: "Run every command OUTSIDE your sandbox"
